# Vendored assets

These files are copied into the mockup so it runs offline.

## htmx

- File: `htmx.min.js`
- Version: 2.0.4
- Source: <https://unpkg.com/htmx.org@2.0.4/dist/htmx.min.js>
- License: MIT
- Project: <https://htmx.org/>

## Silkscreen

- Files: `fonts/Silkscreen-Regular.ttf`, `fonts/Silkscreen-Bold.ttf`
- Version: v6 (Google Fonts)
- Source: <https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Silkscreen>
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1

The fonts are used only by the mockup, not by the radio firmware.
